hero_director_rules: If enemy channeler alive and objective not near completion: EZ targets channeler.
If ally HP < 72% in range: Dr.Feed heals before attacking.
If Dr.Feed HP < 68% and CandyPeace nearby: CandyPeace guards Dr.Feed.
Objective action is preferred when channeler pressure is controlled.
enemy_director_rules: Acolytes pressure objective only when heroes made progress.
Enemies target wounded heroes but do not over-focus Dr.Feed.
Melee units close distance via axial hex movement.
